zin_deep_tide_window = {
	# The months of the great tides (month 3 and month 9): the dive window.
	meta_trigger = {
		text = {
			OR = {
				AND = {
					NOT = {
						date < [Y].3.1
					}
					date < [Y].4.1
				}
				AND = {
					NOT = {
						date < [Y].9.1
					}
					date < [Y].10.1
				}
			}
		}
		Y = "[?global.year|0]"
	}
}
